$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file is checked against, for editor autocomplete.

include.description: Globs selecting the schema files to compile, relative to this file. node_modules and the destination are never included.

rootDir.description: The source root the Destination Directory mirrors, relative to this file: a scanned file at <rootDir>/schemas/user.ts is mirrored to <destination>/schemas/user.ts. Every scanned file must sit under it.

destination.description: The Destination Directory to write, relative to this file. Unset, it is .pvl, which also gets a .gitignore. The compiler only replaces a directory it wrote itself.

withTypes.description: Whether to generate each compiled Schema's Data and Input type aliases.

watch.description: Whether `pvl compile` keeps running and recompiles on every change.
